description: Retrieve a single Coordination Connection (CC) by its `connection_id` (e.g. "CC-06-11-3"). Use when you have the exact identifier; to list or filter CCs, use `get_connections`. Returns the CC with full evidence on the full tier — or when an endpoint is a sample event — and the base fields only otherwise.
name: get_connection_by_id
title: Get Coordination Connection by ID
